messages:
mira: quick overnight summary — ran funcall compliance sweep for int4x (new quant config) vs fp16 baseline on the 3k onboarding corpus
jon: headline numbers?
mira: int4x: schema_deviation_rate 7.8% (233/3k), strict_schema_fail 6.1% ; fp16 baseline: 0.4% / 0.2% respectively
anya: that's a big regression. any dominant failure classes?
mira: breakdown:
- stream-split tokens (quoted strings / punctuation): causes extra quotes or broken braces
- retry-replay duplication: duplicate keys or repeated array elements
- extraneous nulls / stray commas inserted in args
kevin: paste two representative fuzz outputs

```
fuzzer-bot: sample_A712.json
{"tool":"patch_profile","args":{"id":77,"changes":{"bio":"Loves coffee","tags":["ml","infra"],}}}
```

```
fuzzer-bot: sample_B003.json
{"tool":"send_alert","args":{"user":9,"msg":"done"}\n}\n```

mira: first is trailing comma after array/object, second is brace duplication across chunk boundary
jon: are these mostly in batch>1/streaming mode? or single-shot too?
mira: overwhelmingly batch>=2 + streaming; single-shot non-streaming is fine
ci-bot: telemetry snapshot: funcall.schema_deviations +9.4x in the run window; retry_count median rose 0.0 -> 1.3
anya: immediate mitigations we discussed before: sentinel wrapper, sanitizer, retry-policy change. any fresh ideas?
kevin: new idea: apply a light-weight post-generation validator that runs a golden prompt reconstructor: if parse fails, ping the model with a short repair prompt ("clean this JSON payload only") in a synchronous retry. Works as a quality backstop but costs token/time
mira: i ran micro-experiments: sentinel prefix "__JSON_START__\n" dropped syntax failures ~68% on a 400-sample smoke for int4x; repair-prompt cleaned ~85% of the remaining but adds ~60-120ms
olga: for rollout we need objective thresholds. propose: schema_failures <= 1% and repair_success_rate >= 90% for 24h on 50k canary calls
anya: plus telemetry: sanitizer_mutations gauge, repair_prompt_invocations, repair_prompt_success
kevin: runtime change: avoid naive token replay in retry actor — switch to sentence-boundary or whole-message replay; also try to preferentially wait up to X ms at chunk boundary if last bytes look like inside string/escaped sequence
mira: action items:
- INF-6600 (mira): attach corpus, repro steps, failure classification
- kevin: implement sentinel canary + retry replay tweak
- anya: implement sanitizer + repair-prompt flow + metrics + dry-run mode
- mira: run a 50k-sample canary overnight and report
ci-bot: ticket INF-6600 created: "int4x-funcall-compliance-onboard-eval"
fuzzer-bot: corpus uploaded to s3://redwood-fuzz/int4x/4360012345/ 3.0k samples
olga: add an A/B eval plan comparing (A) fp16 baseline, (B) int4x with sentinel-only, (C) int4x with sentinel+repair. Track schema_fail_rate, user-visible-tool_errors, mean_latency
jon: schedule 30m sync tomorrow 11:00 PT to review canary results
mira: thanks team :thumbsup:
